title: Underived affine Hom evaluation on complexes
statement: Let f:X to Y be an affine morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], A=f_*O_X its direct-image algebra and T restriction of scalars [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category]. Let H:Mod(O_Y) to Mod(A) be additive, iH:T composed with H naturally isomorphic to internal Hom(T(A),-) [def-pur-sheaf-hom], and T adjoint to H with counit epsilon. Assume epsilon(phi)=iH(phi)(1) on every open and section. There exists a natural isomorphism e:Hom-complex(O_Y[0],-) to the identity [def-pur-hom-complex] such that for every unbounded cochain complex I there exists a chain isomorphism d:T(H(I)) to Hom-complex(A[0],I). Its composite with precomposition by the canonical k:O_Y to f_*O_X, then e_I, equals the termwise counit. No derived category or K-injectivity is assumed.

proof.text: In the product defining Hom from a degree-zero sheaf, all factors except the zero source degree vanish. Projection to the zero factor is an isomorphism; its inverse inserts the given map in that factor and zero in all others. The differential formula reduces to postcomposition by the target differential.

For the unit source, compose that projection with evaluation at one. Its inverse sends x to the linear map r -> r*x. These are inverse sheaf maps and commute with differentials and all chain maps. They give the natural isomorphism e.

The restriction of the direct-image algebra unit is f_*O_X: both have on an open U the module O_X(f^{-1}U), with the scalar action through f.c. Use this sectionwise identity, apply iH in every degree, and then invert the projection in step 1 for the source f_*O_X[0]. This constructs the chain isomorphism d.

Under these projections, precomposition by O_Y -> f_*O_X sends a local linear map phi to the map r -> phi(f.c(r)). Evaluation at one is phi(1), since f.c preserves one. The hypothesis h_eval identifies this with the counit in each degree. Extensionality on opens and sections, followed by chain-map extensionality, proves the equality. Zero rings, empty schemes, zero complexes, and unbounded complexes are included: no exactness of products is used.

theorem affine_hom_complex_evaluation
    {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom f]
    (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace) ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)))
      [H.Additive]
      (iH : H ⋙ SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
          (R := moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
          (R' := moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))
          ⟨Functor.whiskerRight f.c (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)⟩ ≅
        (SheafOfModules.homFunctor Y.sheaf).obj
          (op ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
            (R := moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
            (R' := moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))
            ⟨Functor.whiskerRight f.c (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)⟩).obj
              (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))))))
      (adj₀ : SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
          (R := moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
          (R' := moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))
          ⟨Functor.whiskerRight f.c (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)⟩ ⊣ H)
    (h_eval : ∀ (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (U : Y.Opens)
          (φ : (H.obj F).val.obj (op U)),
        ((adj₀.counit.app F).val.app (op U)).hom φ =
          ((((iH.hom.app F).val.app (op U)).hom φ).app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))).hom
            (1 : (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)).obj.obj (op U))) :
    ∃ e : (homComplexFunctor (R := Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf)).obj
        (op ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf))) ≅ 𝟭 _,
      ∀ I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ,
      ∃ d : (((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
          (R := moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
          (R' := moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))
          ⟨Functor.whiskerRight f.c (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)⟩).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj ((H.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I)) ≅
          homComplex (R := Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf)
            ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
                ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj
                  (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf))) I,
        d.hom ≫ ((homComplexFunctor (R := Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf)).map
          (((CochainComplex.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).map
              (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom)).op)).app I ≫
            e.hom.app I =
              ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex adj₀.counit (.up ℤ)).app I)
